title: LORD, GO BEFORE ME TODAY AND CLEAR MY PATH
text: Father, I come before your [music] throne of grace this morning in the mighty name of Jesus Christ, acknowledging that you are the [music] God who goes before your people. I thank you for the promise in Deuteronomy 31:8 that declares, "You go before me. You are with me. You will not leave me nor forsake me. And therefore, I do not need to fear or be dismayed." Lord, as I step into this new day, I ask that you go before me. Prepare the way. Make the crooked places straight. Make the rough places smooth. Remove every [music] obstacle. Clear every hindrance. Destroy every barrier. Create a path where there seems to be no way. I decree and declare that I do not go into this day alone. I do not face [music] this day in my own strength. I do not navigate this day [singing] with my own wisdom. You go [music] before me. And because you go before me, every place my feet [music] shall tread is already prepared, already secured, already blessed. Lord, [music] go before me into every place I will enter today. Go before me into my home and establish [music] peace there before I wake my family. Go before me into my workplace [music] and create an atmosphere of favor before I arrive. Go before me into every [singing and music] meeting and prepare the hearts of those I will encounter. Go before [music] me into every store, every building, every location, >> [music] >> and let your presence sanctify that space before I step into it. [music] I am not entering any territory unprepared. I am not walking [music] into any situation unannounced. You are my forerunner. You are my advanced team. You are my pioneer.
